title: Earn honestly and let some leave your hand
summary: The path is known in honest earning and open-handed giving. Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
